verified_claims.claim: E. coli T2 紫杉二烯产量 11.3 ± 0.5 mg/L（13.2 mg/gDCW），T4 为 5.0 ± 0.7 mg/L（5.9 mg/gDCW），发酵 72 h
verified_claims.evidence: The titers of taxadiene produced by mutants T2 and T4 at the shaking flask level were 11.3 ± 0.5 mg/L (13.2 mg/gDCW) and 5.0 ± 0.7 mg/L (5.9 mg/gDCW; Figure 2B)

verified_claims.claim: GB127 经 14 天发酵后紫杉二烯 61.9 ± 6.3 μg/L，5 次独立实验重现
verified_claims.evidence: we could detect 61.9 ± 6.3 μg/L taxadiene in the engineered strain GB127… reaching a maximum concentration of 61.9 ± 6.3 μg/L… reproduced in five parallel experiments

verified_claims.claim: 六个异源启动子相对 mRNA 水平范围 4.5×10³（GB93 gpdA）至 3.4×10⁷（GB94 alcA），跨度 >7,000 倍，排序 alcA > agdA > trpC > glaA > oliC > gpdA
verified_claims.evidence: the strength of the promoters ranged from 4.5 × 10³ (GB93) to 3.4 × 10⁷ (GB94), with a span of more than 7,000 times, in the order of alcA > agdA > trpC > glaA > oliC > gpdA

verified_claims.claim: MVA 体外重构最佳酶比 AtoB:ERG13:tHMG1:ERG12:ERG8:MVD1:Idi = 1:10:2:5:5:2:5
verified_claims.evidence: the best ratio of AtoB:ERG13:tHMG1:ERG12:ERG8:MVD1:Idi for terpenoid production is 1:10:2:5:5:2:5

verified_claims.claim: A. alternata TPF6 转录组检出 10612 个预测基因；hmg1 转录水平偏低，erg10/erg13/erg12/erg8/mvd1/idi 满足 IPP/DMAPP 供给
verified_claims.evidence: three samples of A. alternata TPF6 were sequenced, and 10612 predicted genes were detected… the transcript levels of erg10, erg13, erg12, erg8, mvd1, and idi… were satisfactory… the transcription level of hmg1 was relatively low

verified_claims.claim: 本研究首次报道丝状真菌中紫杉二烯生产；首次为 Alternaria 属建立 ATMT 方法
verified_claims.evidence: This is the first demonstration of taxadiene production in filamentous fungi… we developed an ATMT method for the genus Alternaria for the first time

verified_claims.claim: GC-MS 监测 taxadiene 特征离子 m/z 122，保留时间 16.60 min；GB127 与标品质谱碎片 m/z 55, 79, 91, 107, 121, 123, 133, 147, 174, 187, 229, 272 一致
verified_claims.evidence: GC-MS chromatogram of extracted taxadiene ions (m/z 122)… retention time of 16.6 min
